value_policy: Original NetCDF missing masks and nonfinite values remain missing; genuine zero remains observed; no negative-value filtering or imputation
spatial_mean: For each group/date/lag, both native fields averaged over exactly the same pairwise-finite geometric footprints using unchanged piste lengths
unit_policy: Retain raw SPASS values with UNKNOWN unit; OSHD original unit m; no physical subtraction, ratio, MAE, RMSE, calibration or source substitution
unit_review_method: Primary web-tool consultation; original distributed NetCDF attributes independently inspected; no newly archived HTML or fabricated request status/checksum
unit_review_findings: Official SWE2HS example explicitly selects hs_output_unit='cm' and writes unit cm; configurable example does not identify the generation setting or distributed numeric scale of HSCLQMD. EnviDat names SWE2HS but supplies no stored HSCLQMD unit in inspected catalogue.
